plan: Sell all leveraged ETFs (SOXL, SPAL, METU, MUU) to zero.

conservative.read: This conservative approach aims for capital preservation with a target of around 1.5% per month. It significantly reduces leverage and focuses on stable assets, aiming for lower drawdowns.

plan: Trim leveraged ETFs (SOXL, SPAL) to low single digits.
Reduce concentration in METU and MUU.
Trim QQQI to 20% to manage concentration.
Add LMT as a new quality position.
This plan balances risk reduction with growth.
It aims for steady, risk-first growth around 2.5% per month.
balanced.read: This balanced plan targets around 2.5% per month by reducing leverage and concentration while adding a quality name. It aims for risk-first growth with a moderate cash buffer.

plan: Increase exposure to leveraged ETFs (SOXL, SPAL).
Add to concentrated positions in METU and MUU.

aggressive.read: This aggressive plan targets around 4% per month by increasing leverage and concentration in high-scoring setups. It accepts significantly higher potential drawdowns and the daily decay of leveraged ETFs.

plan: Sell all leveraged and high-beta ETFs (SOXL, SPAL, METU, MUU).
Increase QQQI to 30% for income generation.

income.read: This income-focused plan targets around 1% per month by prioritizing income-generating assets and broad market exposure. It aims for low drawdowns and reliable distributions, with growth being a secondary objective.
